subject: Discovery: Private/VPC security posture & SOC 2 / Vendor questionnaire
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Holt <jessica.holt@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Private/VPC security posture + next steps

Thanks Jessica — good to meet earlier. Quick recap and agreed next steps from the 30m discovery: 

Summary of what we covered:
- Acme priority: strict network isolation for PII workloads, regulatory requirements (GDPR + potential HIPAA scope), and an emphasis on supplier assurance (SOC 2).
- Redwood options that map to this need: Private/VPC deployment (customer VPC peering or private link), Dedicated reserved capacity, and an on-prem/air-gapped package for high-assurance environments.
- Data controls: KMS integrations, audit logs, and fine-grained routing policies can limit model access to specific workloads.

Open questions we captured:
1) Current SOC 2 posture & timeline from Acme side (for scoping evidence and redlines).
2) Whether Acme will require an entirely air-gapped appliance or an isolated VPC with strict egress controls.
3) Which team owns the network diagram & firewall rules on your side for an architecture call.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
- Redwood to initiate vendor security questionnaire and provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report. (Owner: Marcus) — target: 48h
- Schedule a technical architecture call with Acme network/security and our Private deployment team to walk the deployment diagram and egress/inbound rules (Owner: Jessica + Redwood SE) — propose 60m in next 5 business days
- Share a VPC checklist and sample deployment diagram for your review (Owner: Redwood) — attached after confirmation

If that aligns, I’ll start the questionnaire and share links/attachments. Thanks again — plz reply with best times for the architecture call.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Jessica Holt <jessica.holt@acme.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Private/VPC security posture + next steps

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick items from our side: 

- SOC 2: Acme requires SOC 2 Type II evidence for any vendor storing or processing customer PII. We are currently collecting vendor reports — can you provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II and a high-level SOC 2 scope?
- Questionnaire: Yes, please initiate the vendor security questionnaire. We prefer a secure questionnaire link (SaaS) rather than emailing spreadsheets.
- Air-gap vs VPC: For Phase 1 we are evaluating an isolated VPC with no public egress (strict NAT and egress filtering). If that meets requirements, air-gapped appliance may not be necessary, but we’ll confirm after the architecture call.
- Architecture call attendees: I’ll bring our Lead Network Engineer (Samir Patel) and InfoSec Manager (Laura Chen). Can you loop in your Private deployment lead and a solutions engineer?

Times: I’m available Thu 3/4 10-12 PT or Fri 3/5 9-11 PT.

Please share the questionnaire link and redacted SOC 2. Thanks — Jessica

Jessica Holt
Head of Cloud Security | Acme Corporation
jessica.holt@acme.com | (212) 555-0199

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Acme security follow-up — notes for questionnaire & private options

Quick internal note with answers we can share on the questionnaire and call prep: 

SOC 2 / compliance:
- Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II (current period) for the hosted platform. We can provide a redacted report (no customer data) and a scope statement.
- GDPR: Data residency controls and DPA available; we support processor-level controls and sub-processor disclosure.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA bounded deployments for customers that execute a BAA + Private deployment patterns.

Private/VPC/on-prem posture:
- VPC model: customer VPC peering or AWS PrivateLink options; we support strict egress controls and work with your network to lock down NAT/Gateway.
- Air-gapped: We offer an on-prem appliance package for fully air-gapped installs — typically requires professional services and a longer lead time (SLA diff & offline key injection for KMS).
- Attachments to prepare: sample private deployment diagram, VPC checklist, and redacted SOC 2. I’ll attach the most up-to-date artifacts for Marcus to send.

SE notes (Dylan) to prep for call: bring a templated diagram, list of required ports, and example firewall rules for 1:1 review.

-Neha

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Holt <jessica.holt@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: Private/VPC security posture + next steps

Jessica — thanks, confirmed. Next steps from Redwood below and artifacts attached. 

What we’re sending now:
- Vendor security questionnaire (secure link): https://secureforms.redwood.com/questionnaire/rdw-acme-20260302 (owner: Marcus)
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (attachment): SOC2_Type2_redacted.pdf
- Private deployment diagram & VPC checklist (attachments): redwood_private_deployment_diagram.pdf, VPC_deployment_checklist.xlsx

Notes on air-gap vs VPC:
- Based on your stated Phase 1 preference (isolated VPC with no public egress), our VPC deployment with strict egress controls + customer-managed KMS is a standard configuration we’ve delivered for regulated customers. It usually meets GDPR and typical HIPAA deployment requirements when combined with a signed BAA.
- Air-gapped on-prem deployments are available if you determine full physical isolation is required — this path will involve PS for deployment and key injection steps (we can scope in the architecture call).

Proposed architecture call times (60m): Thu 3/4 10:00 PT or Fri 3/5 09:00 PT. Please confirm which works for you and I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda (diagram review, network/ports, KMS/key management, timeline).

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_redacted.pdf; redwood_private_deployment_diagram.pdf; VPC_deployment_checklist.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
